plan.title: Could a Robot Survive on Mars?

input.text:
Built to last ninety days on Mars. It kept going for fourteen years.

Could a robot survive on Mars? NASA's Opportunity rover was built to last ninety days and kept going for more than fourteen years. Mars rarely smashes the robots we send. It wears them down, with cold, dust and wear you already know from home.

Solar panels and luck with the wind, or a nuclear heart that never goes dark: which would you give a Mars robot?

Full film on YouTube. Link in bio.
